# `assertion_02`

CIRCT's own assertion, in CIRCT's own source, with a CIRCT `file:line`: `InstanceGraph::getInferredTopLevelNodes` asserted that an acyclic instance graph has at least one candidate top-level node, and a module whose only operation is a `func.func` has none, so `--sv-trace-iverilog` aborted before it could emit the diagnostic the fix later added. It is the `assertion` fixture whose site is inside the build being tested rather than inside an SDK header, which is what FR-07.4's "name a CIRCT source file and line" is asserted against, and it is the one whose `fingerprint_frame` 03-LLD.md 3.7.1 produces correctly (`circt::igraph::InstanceGraph::getInferredTopLevelNodes InstanceGraph.cpp`), because the crashing function is in a named namespace. It carries two further observations. Its `out_of_scope_root` is `true` although the bug is entirely CIRCT's: frames #9, #10 and #11 share one address, #11 being `InstanceGraph.cpp:221`, and 3.6.2 step 4 reads only the first of the three, which is an inlined `mlir/IR/Diagnostics.h` line. And its RUN line is the one that shows `corpus.strip_probe_only_options` missing CIRCT's single-dash spelling: `-verify-diagnostics` survives into `argv.json`, and at the seed commit it is what turns the emitted diagnostic into exit status 0.

Mined by `analysis/measurements/w09_attempt.sh` on 2026-09-14 from seed `88d9a5ad7a3a` (`test/Dialect/SV/sv-trace-iverilog-errors.mlir`), observed at its first parent `5481d1901ca0` built against `firtool-1.143.0`; the same input at the seed commit does not fire. Tool `circt-opt`, class `assertion`, signal `SIGABRT`.

`stderr.txt`, `expected.json:assertion_site` and the frame paths carry the mining host's build prefix (`/home/adi/.cache/chia-pin-smoke/w09/wt143` for CIRCT sources, `/home/adi/.cache/chia-pin-smoke/w09/sdk-1.143.0` for the SDK), not the image's `/workspace/circt/` and `/opt/circt-sdk/`. 03-LLD.md 3.7.1 strips the build prefix before the site enters a fingerprint, so the prefix is evidence and never a compared value; the relative site is `lib/Support/InstanceGraph.cpp:230`.
